d: Lululemon founder Chip Wilson has sparked outrage after reportedly suggesting that Canadian women are not having as many children as men want — and that some men may need to 'import brides' from Thailand. The controversial remarks, made at a leadership forum in Calgary, reportedly left attendees stunned, with some walking out. Organiser Axis Connects condemned the comments, calling them offensive and inconsistent with its values. Wilson's spokesperson has pushed back against the backlash.
